sample:2026-2027:334:3.jd_text: The goal for our GET program in the Department of Product Ownership is to forge the future leaders of electric mobility. We are seeking a select few to navigate through the complexities of building technology and manufacturing products with a first principles approach, and be at the forefront of driving Athers mission. This is not a product management role, which has a completely different job description. Product Owners at Ather are in-charge of delivering engineering projects / programs, balancing time, cost and quality. Over 24 months, you will embark on a high-velocity journey through Athers development ecosystem. It is a fully immersive experience to build a product owner from the ground up. Each rotation is a deep dive into a specific function, where you will be given meaningful, technically challenging work that supports critical business priorities ○ Phase 1: Engineering and validation - Hands-on understanding of what it takes to build our products - vehicle engineering, powertrain dynamics, battery technology and software. Own a component or part of code and ship it to our customers. Understand the way we build our technology fundamentally ○ Phase 2: Industrialisation and supply-chain - Work alongside our manufacturing engineering and supply-chain teams to take a design from a prototype to industrialising it for scale. Learn what it takes to work with partner suppliers, and the considerations (financial, operational and technical) at play for manufacturing parts that need to be supplied at scale at utmost reliability ○ Phase 3: Financial acumen - get acquainted with financial tools that help to do what it takes to run development operations including budgeting, setting PnL targets, technology benchmarking, zero-based costing, and writing out compelling business cases for pitching newer ideas. ● Post an assessment at the end of 2 years including technical depth as well as soft skills such as the ability to negotiate, lead without formal authority and being comfortable working with ambiguity, you shall commence work as a Product Owner / Associate Product Owner for one of our modules ● As a Product Owner, you will take charge of a cross-functional development team to define its roadmap in alignment with Athers vision and near-term objectives, pitch your roadmap to the upper management to obtain resources to fund your projects, and then get into the weeds with the relevant cross-functional teams and deliver those projects. Along the way, you will have to set priorities, make many micro-decisions in terms of where to take risks and where not to by assessing trade-offs, decide whether to outsource a certain aspect of the project or do it in-house, negotiate with various stakeholders across the board on specifications / costs / manufacturing strategy / timelines, and inspire your team to achieve exceptional results in a way that is uniquely Ather

sample:2026-2027:461:1.jd_text: Software Engineer, Gen AI & Robotics About PhyAgents PhyAgents is a high-growth foundation model startup headquartered in San Jose, California. Founded by Stanford alumni, it sits at the intersection of the two biggest platform shifts of our time: foundation models and robotics. PhyAgents is backed by three Stanford professors, top AI leaders, and deep tech investors who run AI and compute at the top of the field. PhyAgents is building the Claude Code for Physical AI: a robotic foundation model plus a physical agentic framework for reliable, long-horizon operations in industrial environments. It delivers complete semi-humanoid robots as a workforce for industrial applications. Their physical agents (or robots) combine: a robotic foundation model, force-aware manipulation, long-horizon reasoning, step-by-step execution verified against real operating procedures, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. The robot plans the job, executes each step, checks their work, and when it isnt certain it doesn't guessit escalates. About the Team CEO and co-founder: Serial entrepreneur and former VP at Intel. Previously raised >$50M, scaled and exited a robotics company. PhD from Stanford. CTO and co-founder: Key foundation models leader from Apple. Previously led perception for self-driving. MS from Stanford, B.Tech from IIT Madras. The team includes executives and AI leaders from Apple, Intel, Marvell, Samsung, Uber, Panasonic and Lockheed Martin. Why join now Youll be among the first engineers in the India team of a Silicon Valley deep tech startup. Youll work on the same problems, with the same bar, as our team in San Jose. This is not a satellite office working off tickets. The India team is a core part of how we build models, data, and infrastructure, and youll own real pieces of the stack from your first quarter. Most new grads join a large company and work on one small corner of a mature product. Here youll work across the whole stack, contribute at the cutting edge, see your code move a robot, and grow as fast as the company does. The field has shown broad competence across many tasks, and almost never 99.9% reliability on even one. That gap is the company. Closing it takes models that learn from demonstration and improve through practice, a data flywheel that turns every failure into training signal, and software that runs on real robots in real industrial environments. About the role Youll build the software that turns a capable robot into a product customers rely on, from the Claude code like agentic harness, the cloud services and data infrastructure down to the robot software itself. What youll work on Physical agentic framework: Build agents that turn a job into a plan of steps, execute each one, verify it against real operating procedures, and escalate to a human when unsure. Build in tool use, memory, failure recovery, and human-in-the-loop handoffs. Cloud planners and fleet orchestration: Build services that break work orders into tasks, schedule them across robot fleets, and track progress and exceptions in real time. Vertical integrations and product: Connect our agents to each industrys existing systems, such as data center management, ticketing, maintenance workflows, and manufacturing execution systems. Build customer-facing dashboards, job setup, and audit trails. On-robot software and hardware integration: Build the ROS-based stack for perception, control, and task execution. Bring up and integrate robot arms, sensors, cameras, and teleop rigs. Data infrastructure and tooling: Build ingest, storage, indexing, and retrieval for large volumes of multimodal robot data. Build the tools our data operations team uses daily for capture, review, and annotation. Training and evaluation infrastructure: Partner with ML engineers on job orchestration, compute management, and reproducible pipelines. What were looking for Minimum B.Tech, M.Tech or PhD (graduating 2027) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related branch Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and systems design Fluency in Python and at least one of C++, Rust, Go, or TypeScript At least one substantial project you built and shipped, where other people used it or it ran on something real Preferred Experience building with LLMs and agents: tool use, planning, and agent frameworks Experience with backend services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP, containers, databases) Frontend experience: you can put a usable UI in front of a backend (React or similar) Experience with ROS or ROS 2, embedded systems, or real-time software Experience with distributed systems or data pipelines (object storage, Ray or Spark, Parquet) Robotics clubs or competitions, or hardware hobby projects Internships at product companies or startups, or meaningful open-source contributions What we value Ownership. You finish things. A result that doesnt run on the robot isnt finished. Rigor. You catch the subtle bug that the dashboard says is fine. Range. Youre as willing to debug a data pipeline or a ROS node as a training run. Comfort with real hardware. Our models run on robots, and youll spend time in the lab. Speed of learning. Theres no playbook. Youll be learning new parts of the stack every month. Ambition. You want to build something that matters at the frontier of AI and robotics. Clear communication. Youll work daily across San Jose, Bengaluru, and our data operations team in Nepal.

sample:2026-2027:461:2.jd_text: About PhyAgents PhyAgents is a high-growth foundation model startup headquartered in San Jose, California. Founded by Stanford alumni, it sits at the intersection of the two biggest platform shifts of our time: foundation models and robotics. PhyAgents is backed by three Stanford professors, top AI leaders, and deep tech investors who run AI and compute at the top of the field. PhyAgents is building the Claude Code for Physical AI: a robotic foundation model plus a physical agentic framework for reliable, long-horizon operations in industrial environments. It delivers complete semi-humanoid robots as a workforce for industrial applications. Their physical agents (or robots) combine: a robotic foundation model, force-aware manipulation, long-horizon reasoning, step-by-step execution verified against real operating procedures, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. The robot plans the job, executes each step, checks their work, and when it isnt certain it doesn't guessit escalates. About the Team CEO and co-founder: Serial entrepreneur and former VP at Intel. Previously raised >$50M, scaled and exited a robotics company. PhD from Stanford. CTO and co-founder: Key foundation models leader from Apple. Previously led perception for self-driving. MS from Stanford, B.Tech from IIT Madras. The team includes executives and AI leaders from Apple, Intel, Marvell, Samsung, Uber, Panasonic and Lockheed Martin. Why join now Youll be among the first engineers in the India team of a Silicon Valley deep tech startup. Youll work on the same problems, with the same bar, as our team in San Jose. This is not a satellite office working off tickets. The India team is a core part of how we build models, data, and infrastructure, and youll own real pieces of the stack from your first quarter. Most new grads join a large company and work on one small corner of a mature product. Here youll work across the whole stack, contribute at the cutting edge, see your code move a robot, and grow as fast as the company does. The field has shown broad competence across many tasks, and almost never 99.9% reliability on even one. That gap is the company. Closing it takes models that learn from demonstration and improve through practice, a data flywheel that turns every failure into training signal, and software that runs on real robots in real industrial environments. About the role At PhyAgents, a machine learning engineer works across the full loop that makes a robot better: data, models, training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment on real hardware. Youll do research-grade work and ship it onto robots in the same quarter. A result that doesnt run on the robot isnt finished. What youll work on Training and post-training: Train and post-train robotic foundation models, including vision-language-action models, using imitation learning and reinforcement learning. Youll own the work from data loading through multi-GPU training runs. Training infrastructure: Build and scale distributed multi-node GPU training, data loaders that keep GPUs fed, and reproducible pipelines with experiment tracking. Simulation: Build simulation environments for our tasks. Train policies with reinforcement learning that transfer to real robots. Rewards and verifiers: Design the reward functions and the verifiers that check whether a task step actually succeeded. Evaluation: Build harnesses that tell us whether a model actually got better, in simulation and on real hardware. Design the metrics that decide what ships. Data and data infrastructure: Define what data the models need. Build the pipelines that turn raw robot episodes into versioned, training-ready datasets. Trace a stuck policy back to its data. Models on robots: Get models running reliably and fast enough on real hardware. Debug failures in the lab across the model, the data, and the robot. What were looking for Minimum B.Tech, M.Tech or PhD (graduating 2027) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related branch Strong fundamentals in linear algebra, probability, optimization, and machine learning Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and systems Fluency in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch or Tensorflow At least one serious ML project you can go deep on: a course project, internship, research, or something you built yourself. Preferred Publications in AI, open-source contributions, or strong competition results (Kaggle, robotics contests) Research or internship experience in deep learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, or robotics Experience with post-training transformers, diffusion models, or multimodal models Experience with distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed) or GPU performance work (CUDA, profiling) Experience with data pipelines or large datasets (object storage, Ray or Spark, Parquet, WebDataset) Exposure to robot simulation (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, PyBullet) or real robot hardware Robotics clubs or competitions, or hardware hobby projects What we value Ownership. You finish things. A result that doesnt run on the robot isnt finished. Rigor. You catch the subtle bug that the dashboard says is fine. Range. Youre as willing to debug a data pipeline or a ROS node as a training run. Comfort with real hardware. Our models run on robots, and youll spend time in the lab. Speed of learning. Theres no playbook. Youll be learning new parts of the stack every month. Ambition. You want to build something that matters at the frontier of AI and robotics. Clear communication. Youll work daily across San Jose, Bengaluru, and our data operations team in Nepal.

PRODUCT MANAGER – TRADING PLATFORM
Department: Product Management / FinTech Product Development
Location: Mumbai / Indore
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: Freshers from Premier Institutes
Target Institutes: IITs
About the Role
We are looking for highly analytical, technology-driven and ambitious Product Managers to build
the next generation of digital trading and investment platforms.
This is an ownership-driven product role where you will work on real-world products across Web,
Mobile, Trading, Market Data, Derivatives, Analytics and AI-powered financial experiences.
You will work closely with Engineering, Design, QA, Business, Analytics, Growth and Senior
Leadership to identify problems, define solutions, prioritize the roadmap and drive products from
idea to launch and continuous improvement.
This is not a coordination-only role. We are looking for product leaders who can think deeply, solve
complex problems and execute with speed.
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Strategy & Roadmap
• Define and execute product vision, strategy and roadmap.
• Identify customer problems and convert them into scalable product solutions.
• Conduct market, competitor and user research.
• Prioritize features based on customer impact, business value and technical feasibility.
• Define product KPIs and continuously track product performance.
• Work with leadership on strategic product initiatives.
2. Product Discovery & Problem Solving
• Understand user journeys and identify friction points.
• Analyze customer feedback, usage patterns and business data.
• Convert ambiguous business problems into structured product requirements.
• Develop hypotheses, validate ideas and make data-driven product decisions.
• Design simple and intuitive experiences for complex financial products.
3. Product Execution
Own the complete product development lifecycle:
Problem → Research → Ideation → PRD → Design → Development → QA → Launch → Analytics →
Improvement
Work closely with Engineering and Design teams to create:
• PRDs / Product Requirement Documents
• BRDs / Business Requirement Documents
• User Stories
• User Journeys
• Product Workflows
• Acceptance Criteria
• Wireframes / Product Prototypes
• Product Metrics & Dashboards
4. Trading & FinTech Products
You may work on products and features including:
• Equity trading
• Futures & Options
• Order placement and execution
• Positions and holdings
• Portfolio management
• Market Data
• Option Chain
• Payoff Graphs
• Trading Strategies
• Strategy Builders
• Alerts and notifications
• Research and analytics
• Wealth and investment products
• AI-powered trading and investment experiences
A strong interest in stock markets and financial technology is highly desirable.
5. AI-First Product Management
AI adoption is an important part of this role.
You will be expected to use AI as a productivity and product-building advantage across:
• Product research
• Customer insight analysis
• PRD and documentation creation
• Competitive analysis
• Data analysis
• Workflow automation
• Product experimentation
• AI-powered user experiences
• Intelligent recommendations and personalization
We expect Product Managers to be AI-first thinkers, not just users of traditional product-
management tools.
6. Data & Product Analytics
• Define and monitor product KPIs.
• Analyze user behavior and product funnels.
• Identify adoption and engagement trends.
• Use data to identify product opportunities.
• Work with Analytics/Data teams to build meaningful insights.
• Drive improvements in activation, engagement, retention and conversion.
7. Product Launch & Go-To-Market
• Plan and execute product launches.
• Coordinate with Business, Marketing, Growth, Operations and Support teams.
• Prepare launch plans and product communication.
• Monitor post-launch performance.
• Gather feedback and drive continuous product improvement.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for candidates who demonstrate:
• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving ability.
• Strong structured thinking.
• High ownership and execution mindset.
• Ability to break complex problems into simple solutions.
• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
• Curiosity about technology and digital products.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong bias toward action and experimentation.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.
Technical & Analytical Skills
Candidates with exposure to the following will be preferred:
• Product Management fundamentals
• SQL
• Excel / Google Sheets
• Product Analytics
• Data visualization
• A/B testing
• User research
• Product documentation
• API / technology fundamentals
• Agile / Scrum methodologies
Coding knowledge is not mandatory, but technical understanding and the ability to work
effectively with engineering teams is highly preferred.
AI Skills – Preferred
Candidates should have exposure to:
• Generative AI
• LLMs
• Prompt Engineering
• AI productivity tools
• AI-assisted research
• AI-assisted product development
• AI-powered analytics
• Workflow automation
Candidates who have built AI-based projects, prototypes or products will be strongly preferred.
Educational Qualification
We are primarily looking for candidates from:
• IITs and other premier institutes
Preferred Candidate Profile
We would especially value candidates who have:
• Built a product/project from idea to execution.
• Participated in hackathons or product competitions.
• Built fintech, trading or AI projects.
• Experience with startups or product organizations.
• Strong interest in financial markets.
• Experience using SQL/data for decision-making.
• Demonstrated leadership through college projects, clubs or entrepreneurial initiatives.
What You Will Get
High Ownership
Own meaningful product problems and see your decisions translate into live products.
Real FinTech Exposure
Work on products used by real users across trading and investment journeys.
Technology + Product
Work closely with Engineering, Data, AI and Design teams.
Leadership Exposure
Opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and participate in important product and
business decisions.
AI-First Environment
Build products and workflows using modern AI technologies.
Fast Career Growth
High performers will get opportunities to take ownership of larger product areas and grow into
senior product leadership roles.
Why Join Us?
Build products. Solve real problems. Learn markets. Use AI. Own outcomes.
You will not be joining as a traditional management trainee or coordinator. You will be expected to
think like a product owner and execute like a builder.
If you are someone who enjoys asking:
“Why are we building this?”
“Can we build it better?”
“What does the data tell us?”
“How can AI transform this experience?”
—this role is for you.

sample:2026-2027:277:7.jd_text: About Collins Aerospace Collins Aerospace, an RTX business, is a global leader in aerospace and defense, delivering cutting-edge systems, components, and services that help make aviation safer, more connected and more efficient. With deep expertise across avionics, mission systems, aerostructures, interiors, mechanical systems, power and controls, and advanced aerospace technologies, Collins Aerospace supports commercial, business, defense, and space customers around the world. Its broad engineering heritage and global scale provide a strong foundation for solving complex aerospace challenges and shaping the future of flight. About Applied Research & Technology At Applied Research and Technology (ART), we work at the intersection of research, engineering, and innovation to shape technologies that can influence the future of aerospace. Working with engineering and technology teams across the globe, ART transforms promising ideas into proofs of concept, technology demonstrators, advanced engineering capabilities, and pathways toward future products. The Opportunity We are looking for curious and technically strong Masters and PhD graduates with a foundation in aerospace or aviation systems who are excited to explore how future aircraft and airspace systems can become more intelligent, connected, aware, and autonomous. As part of the Autonomous & Intelligent Systems team, you will work on emerging technologies and system concepts across areas such as airspace operations, surveillance, next-generation weather, sensor fusion, decision support, and pilot-centered autonomy. You will have the opportunity to combine your aerospace fundamentals with emerging techniques in AI/ML, sensing, data fusion, intelligent algorithms, and autonomous systems to address existing aviation challenges and help create capabilities for future products. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding complex aerospace systems, exploring problems where the solution may not already exist, and turning ideas into algorithms, models, simulations, prototypes, and technology demonstrators. What You Will Work On Depending on the research problem and your area of specialization, you will:  Explore technologies and algorithms for autonomous and intelligent aerospace systems, from early research through proof of concept and technology demonstration.  Develop and evaluate sensor and information fusion techniques to create more accurate and reliable awareness of the aircraft and its operating environment.  Investigate next-generation capabilities for airspace operations, aircraft surveillance, traffic awareness, and decision support.  Explore new approaches to weather sensing, turbulence and atmospheric awareness, prediction, and integration of weather information into aircraft decision-making.  Develop concepts for pilot-centered autonomy and human-autonomy teaming, where intelligent systems enhance situational awareness and support effective pilot decision-making.  Apply AI/ML, advanced algorithms, optimization, modelling, and data-driven techniques to aerospace system problems where appropriate.  Work with aircraft, sensor, surveillance, weather, trajectory, and other engineering data to develop and validate new concepts.  Build models, simulations, prototypes, and technology demonstrators to evaluate the feasibility and value of emerging system concepts.  Collaborate with aerospace domain experts, researchers, product teams, and global stakeholders to mature promising technologies toward future applications.  Contribute to technology roadmaps, invention disclosures, patents, research publications, technical papers, and external research forums. Who We Are Looking For We are looking for individuals who combine strong aerospace fundamentals, systems thinking, analytical ability, and a genuine curiosity to explore the future of aviation. You should have:  A Masters or PhD degree in Aerospace Engineering, Avionics, Electrical/Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Controls, Robotics, Autonomous Systems, or a closely related discipline.  A good foundational understanding of aircraft, avionics, aerospace systems, or aviation operations.  Academic, thesis, research, or project experience in one or more areas such as navigation, surveillance, sensing, controls, guidance, estimation, autonomous systems, signal processing, or aerospace modelling and simulation.  Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with an interest in understanding complex system- level interactions and behaviours.  Programming and modelling skills using tools or languages such as Python, MATLAB/Simulink, C, or C++.  Ability to translate an engineering problem into models, algorithms, simulations, experiments, or prototypes and critically evaluate the results.  Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging areas such as sensor fusion, AI/ML, intelligent systems, autonomy, and advanced aerospace algorithms.  Strong communication and collaboration skills for working across multidisciplinary and globally distributed teams. Candidates are not expected to have expertise across all these technologies. We value strong fundamentals and depth in your area of specialization, coupled with the curiosity and ability to learn across disciplines. What Success Looks Like In this role, you will grow from contributing to advanced AI research problems to independently identifying research opportunities, formulating technical questions, evaluating state-of-the-art approaches, and developing novel solutions that can influence future aerospace technologies and products. sample:2026-2027:451:1.jd_text: At FirstClub, product isnt just about features and roadmaps  its about building the foundation of trust that defines our brand. Every product decision we make either earns customer trust or erodes it. Were hiring product folks to own either of the 3 distinct, high-impact problems that directly shape how customers experience FirstClub. You wont be shadowing PMs or writing user stories for someone elses roadmap. Youll define the problem, dive deep into data, talk to customers, write the spec, work with engineering and design, ship the solution, and own the metric. Each intern will be assigned one of the three projects below. The 3 Projects: 1. Supply Chain Quality & Transparency In modern supply chains which involve multiple stages, maintaining consistent product quality across sourcing, warehousing, transportation, and delivery remains a major challenge due to fragmented processes and limited visibility across stakeholders. Customers often lack transparency into how products are handled throughout the value chain, leading to reduced trust and inconsistent experiences. The project aims to explore and design scalable tools that improve quality tracking, operational transparency, and accountability across the supply chain, enabling businesses to ensure reliable product quality and build greater customer trust. 2. Customer Retention Retention is the truest measure of whether customers love what were building. This project focuses on understanding why customers come back, why some dont, and what we can do to bring them back more often. Youll dig into cohort behavior, decode usage patterns, identify lifecycle moments that matter most (onboarding, habit formation, churn risk, win-back), and design and ship interventions that move the retention curve. Success here directly translates into long-term business health. 3. Overall App Experience The app is the primary surface where customers experience FirstClub. This project focuses on systematically identifying friction, drop-offs, and delight opportunities across the entire customer journey  product discovery, browsing, search, cart, checkout, post-order tracking, and re-engagement. Youll combine quantitative funnel analysis with qualitative user research to ship UX and feature interventions that make the FirstClub app the highest-quality grocery experience in India. What Youll Work On:  Framing problems clearly from first principles  Writing SQL queries and pulling data yourself  you wont be waiting on analysts  Synthesising insights from customer interviews, support tickets, and behavioral data  Writing crisp PRDs that engineers and designers actually want to build from  Running experiments and reading results honestly  Working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, design, ops, and category teams  Owning a real metric  not just a feature shipped Why This Role Is Different: Most early product roles involve shadowing PMs and shipping nothing. At FirstClub, youll own a real problem from day one. This means:  Youll be measured on outcomes, not output  Youll have direct access to founders and senior leadership  Youll ship to real customers, not slides  Youll learn how product gets built in an AI-native, high-velocity startup  Youll touch every part of the stack: data, design, engineering, operations Required Skills & Traits: We care far more about mindset than pedigree. We value people who:  Learn insanely fast  Are highly curious  Love building things  Have strong ownership mentality  Can think from first principles  Obsess over customer experience  Are comfortable navigating ambiguity  Can leverage AI tools effectively  Thrive in fast-moving environments  Want to create real-world impact Must-Have Skills:  Knowing SQL  or being willing to learn it fast  is a MUST. You will be writing queries from day one. All three projects are deeply data-driven and you cannot rely on someone else to pull numbers for you.  Strong ability to churn through messy data, identify patterns, and extract actionable insights  Comfort with spreadsheets, BI tools, and analytical thinking  Sharp written and verbal communication  you should be able to explain a problem in 3 sentences  Structured problem-solving and the discipline to break ambiguous problems into solvable pieces Bonus if you have:  Built side projects, products, communities, or businesses  Used Cursor / Claude / ChatGPT heavily for research, analysis, or prototyping  Worked on data analysis, analytics, or research projects  Run experiments or A/B tests  Built anything end-to-end independently  Familiarity with Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, Looker, or similar Expected Outcomes: By the end of the program, you should be able to:  Define and frame product problems clearly  Write SQL and pull data independently  Translate raw data and customer signals into product decisions  Write PRDs that engineering and design love to work from  Ship features that move real business metrics  Run experiments end-to-end  hypothesis to readout  Think like a product owner, not a feature factory  Operate with founder-level ownership What Youll Learn:  Product thinking from first principles  Data-driven decision making  Customer research and synthesis  Experimentation and hypothesis testing  Working cross-functionally with engineering, design, and ops  Trade-offs between speed and quality  Business-first product development  How elite startup teams actually operate Specific Courses / Learning Expectations: We strongly encourage familiarity with: Product Foundations  Product management fundamentals  Writing PRDs and product specs  User research basics  Prioritization frameworks (RICE, ICE, etc.) Data & Analytics  SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL syntax)  Cohort analysis and retention metrics  Funnel analysis and conversion math  Advanced Excel / Google Sheets  Tools like Mixpanel / Amplitude / Metabase AI Tools for Product  Using LLMs for research, synthesis, and prototyping  Prompt engineering for product workflows  Cursor / Claude / ChatGPT for everyday product work Recommended Platforms:  Lennys Newsletter  Mode SQL Tutorial / SQLBolt  Mixpanel / Amplitude product analytics courses  Y Combinator startup library  Writings from top product leaders (Shreyas Doshi, Marty Cagan, John Cutler) Culture at FirstClub: We are a close-knit group of builders who genuinely care about:  Product quality  Customer trust  Fast execution  Radical ownership  Open door policy  No unnecessary process theater  Just smart people building ambitious things together Who Should NOT Apply: This role may not be a fit if:  You prefer heavily structured environments  You wait for detailed instructions  You dislike fast iteration cycles  You are uncomfortable with ownership  You think product is about meetings and frameworks, not metrics  You want to write strategy decks without shipping anything  Youre allergic to SQL and getting your hands dirty in data Who Will Thrive Here: Youll love FirstClub if:  Youve ever built something just for fun  You obsess over how products make you feel  You enjoy solving hard, messy, ambiguous problems  You want to work at startup speed  You believe great products come from great taste backed by great data  You want to help build the future instead of watching it happen

sample:2026-2027:297:1.jd_text: FLIPSPACES JOB DESCRIPTION  US SBU Flipsapces - Entrepreneur-in-Residence (FEiR) Flipspaces Technology Labs | US SBU Location: Mumbai, India & United States Reporting To: Business Leaders Function: Cross-functional Leadership Development About Flipspaces Flipspaces is a global design-tech powerhouse reshaping the future of commercial interiors. Its VR-powered platform lets clients visualize and co-create their spaces in real time. Backed by in-house manufacturing and end-to-end execution capabilities, Flipspaces has built over 10 million sq. ft. for top startups, enterprises, co-working brands, and global giants. Born at the intersection of design, tech, and manufacturing, Flipspaces is led by IIT founders and is scaling rapidly across India, the US, Singapore, and the Middle East, with 7 offices and a 500-strong team. Flipspaces recently closed a $50M Series C, with plans to scale its US SBU, double down on AI-powered technology, and pursue strategic acquisitions. The Role The Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EiR) is a high-potential leadership program designed for individuals who want to become owner-operators and future business leaders. This is not a traditional management trainee role. From Day 1, you will work on live business mandates, take ownership of outcomes, solve real operational and commercial problems, and work closely with senior leadership. Over 24 months, you will rotate across four critical areas of the business: Primary Responsibilities 1. Project Management, Design & Execution | India Understand the complete design-to-delivery lifecycle. Work with design and project teams on live projects. Read and interpret GFC drawings and project documentation. Participate in design reviews and client/project discussions. Own a defined project package from planning through execution. Develop an understanding of site execution, quality, timelines, and project delivery. 2. Operations & Procurement | India Work across procurement, vendor management, costing, and supply chain. Develop and manage vendor relationships. Work on BOQs, costing, sourcing, and commercial evaluation. Leverage Flipspaces' technology and sourcing ecosystem to identify products and solutions. Support quality, snag closure, and project-level P&L hygiene. Identify opportunities to improve cost, quality, and delivery efficiency. 3. US Stint  Project Management & Operations | United States Work with the US business and on-ground project teams. Support client and site coordination. Gain exposure to the US vendor and execution ecosystem. Understand US project processes, permitting, and compliance requirements. Work with cross-border teams and stakeholders. Take ownership of defined project and operational mandates. 4. Sales & Business Development | India / United States Build and manage business pipelines. Participate in pre-sales, client pitches, and proposal development. Understand client requirements and translate them into commercial solutions. Support BOQ/proposal discussions and commercial negotiations. Develop key-account understanding and relationship-building skills. Work closely with the Business Development leadership team on closures. What You Will Build By the end of the program, you will have exposure to: Design & Project Management Construction & Execution Procurement & Supply Chain Operations & P&L Sales & Business Development Client & Stakeholder Management US business operations Cross-functional leadership Problem-solving and business ownership Your eventual role will be aligned to your demonstrated strengths, interests, and business requirements, with potential career paths across Sales, Business Development, Project Management, Operations, Design, Procurement, and Supply Chain. Preferred Qualifications & Experience We are looking for high-potential, entrepreneurial individuals who are excited by ambiguity, ownership, and building things from the ground up. Tier-1 institute alumni (IIT/IIM/ISB or equivalent top-tier MBA program) preferred. Bachelor's/Dual degree in: Mechanical Engineering Civil Engineering Architectural Engineering / Architecture Materials / Metallurgical Engineering Construction & Project Management Related engineering or built-environment disciplines Engineering Design Demonstrated leadership through student bodies, technical/cultural fests, sports, placement cells, or other initiatives. Entrepreneurial mindset demonstrated through startups, E-Cell activities, B-plan competitions, live projects, or self-initiated ventures. Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. High ownership and willingness to work in a fast-paced environment. Willingness to travel, rotate across functions, and relocate when required. Strong interest in building a career across both India and the US. What We Look For - Think like owners  Take responsibility for outcomes rather than tasks. Move fast  Are comfortable making decisions and learning through execution. Solve problems  Approach ambiguous problems with structure and initiative. Build relationships  Can work effectively with clients, vendors, teams, and leadership. Learn across functions  Are curious enough to understand the entire business rather than staying within one silo. Have the ambition to lead  Want to eventually own teams, businesses, projects, or P&Ls. Why Join the EiR Program? Real Ownership from Day 1 - Work on live business mandates instead of being limited to shadowing or classroom training. Four Careers in Two Years- Build experience across Design, Execution, Procurement/Operations, and Sales in one accelerated leadership journey. US Exposure- Get an opportunity to work with the US business and gain on-ground exposure to the American design-build and project ecosystem. Technology + Design + Business- Work at the intersection of technology, design, construction, procurement, and business. Leadership Access- Work closely with senior leaders and gain direct exposure to business decisions and strategic priorities. Build Your Own Career Path- Your eventual role will be shaped by your strengths, interests, demonstrated performance, and Flipspaces' business needs. The Opportunity - If you are someone who doesn't want to spend the first few years of your career simply learning one function, the EiR program gives you an opportunity to understand the business end-to-end, take ownership early, and build towards a future leadership role. Come build the future of Design-to-Build with Flipspaces.When working from the Mumbai office, the working hours will be 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST (these timings are subject to change based on business requirements) www.flipspaces.com

sample:2026-2027:175:1.jd_text: Data/App Engineer  Job Description Location: Pune, India Type: Full-Time Department: Product Engineering Reports To: Director of Engineering --- ## About Us At NexusOne, we are building the data and AI infrastructure that powers the next generation of enterprise intelligence. We believe AI is only as good as the data behind it  and most enterprises are not yet ready. That is the problem we solve. Our platform, NexusOne, is a composable data lakehouse built on Apache Iceberg, Spark, and Trino. It gives enterprises the modern, governed, AI-ready data foundation they need to move from experimentation to production  fast. Our clients include some of the largest financial institutions in the world, and we handle the hard work of data modernization so they can focus on what matters: making smarter decisions and building intelligent products. We are a team of builders across the US and India, and we are growing fast. --- ## The Opportunity We are looking for a Data/App Engineer to join our product and delivery team  someone who is excited about working at the intersection of modern data engineering and AI. This is not a maintenance role. You will be building the pipelines, features, and integrations that power real enterprise AI deployments, including agentic workflows that put data to work autonomously. You will work closely with solution architects and senior engineers to onboard enterprise customers onto NexusOne, build new product features, and contribute to the AI-native capabilities that make our platform differentiated. If you are intellectually curious, love learning new technologies, and want to see your work running at scale in production, this is the right place. --- ## What You Will Do - Assist in onboarding enterprise customer workloads to NexusOne, including data ingestion, transformation, analytics, AI ops, and application modernization - Build and deploy new product features with a focus on performance, quality, and scale - Contribute to agentic data workflows  pipelines and integrations that enable AI agents to act on enterprise data in real time - Work with modern data technologies including Kubernetes, Apache Spark, dbt, Trino, Airflow, and Iceberg - Use Python, Java, or Scala to implement product features and modernize customer workloads - Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities; contribute to team knowledge sharing and continuous improvement - Troubleshoot and debug data issues under the guidance of senior engineers - Participate in product roadmap discussions and rapid proof-of-concept evaluations --- ## Who You Are - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field - Foundational understanding of data structures, algorithms, and coding best practices (flow control, inheritance, separation of concerns, error handling, etc.) - Experience or coursework with Python, Java/Scala, and/or .NET languages - Familiarity with backend concepts including object-oriented design, ETL, and REST APIs - Genuine curiosity about AI, agentic systems, and how data infrastructure enables intelligent automation - Experience with database systems such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Snowflake - Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a self-directed learning mindset - Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across a distributed team - Preferred: familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and open source data projects --- ## Why NexusOne At NexusOne, you will be working on problems that actually matter  at the foundation of enterprise AI. The work is hard, the technology is cutting edge, and the team is excellent. We are building a culture where curiosity is rewarded, ownership is expected, and every engineer has a meaningful impact on what we ship. We are deeply committed to a collaborative, supportive environment where every voice is valued and every team member can grow. If you are ready to build the infrastructure that powers the next wave of enterprise intelligence, we would love to meet you.

sample:2026-2027:215:1.jd_text: About Meesho Meesho started with a bold idea - to make internet commerce accessible to every Indian, everywhere. A decade later, we've grown into India's largest horizontal e-commerce platform for the next billion users - but the mission hasn't changed: Democratize internet commerce for everyone. Our name - Meri Shop - reflects who we build for: the small business owner in Bharat. Whether it's a saree seller in Surat, a reseller in Ranchi, or a first-time shopper in a Tier-3 town - we're their platform of choice. We've helped millions of sellers to go online, with zero commission, lowest logistics cost, and a deeply localized, relatable assortment that mirrors how India shops. But we're more than just an app - we're a culture of first principles thinking, humility, and high ownership. We've built a company that moves fast, thinks long-term, and empowers people to take big bets early in their careers. Our 10-year journey has been one of experimentation, pivots, resilience, and impact. From being India's top reseller platform to becoming the first Indian e-commerce company to turn profitable, we've done what few thought was possible - all while keeping our users and sellers at the heart of every decision. So if you're looking to build for Bharat, solve complex problems at scale, and be part of a team that values courage over convention - Meesho is the place for you. About the Role: Senior Associate  Business Management Track This is not your average entry-level job. As a Senior Associate, you'll be thrown into the deep end from Day 1. You'll get end-to-end exposure to solving 10x problems, owning business charters, working with CXOs, and shaping strategies that directly impact millions of users and sellers across India. You'll join one of our core business verticals, working in small, high-impact teams. You'll solve real business challenges, use data like second nature, and move at the speed of a startup. With AI as a force multiplier, expect your individual ownership to expand well beyond a traditional job title - you'll increasingly get to own outcomes end-to-end, not just a narrow slice of the problem, with the flexibility to grow deeper into business or lean into product as you go. What You'll Work On You'll be mapped to one of the following tracks based on your interest and business needs: Commerce Platform Own the core marketplace flywheel  driving user acquisition, activation, and retention while strengthening the seller ecosystem and expanding categories and selection. Shape strategies across discovery, pricing, and monetization to make Meesho the most affordable, personalized shopping destination for Bharat. Make Meesho a trusted shopping destination through competitive pricing, a reliable marketplace, and a differentiated branded experience on Mall. Power content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven journeys that improve engagement, trust, and conversion. Work with product, tech, and analytics to scale India's largest marketplace toward 1Bn+ users and 10M+ sellers. Fulfilment & Experience Empower every seller with a zero-loss, friction-free & predictable operating system. Enable a trusted channel for users to buy without hesitation through faster delivery timelines, seamless delivery experience, and support through the post-order journey. Work with product, tech, and ops teams to build the lowest-cost, reliable & efficient supply chain that enables selling everything on Meesho. (kept as-is  this is your existing track definition and already matches the BU) Financial Services Build and scale Meesho's lending business  Paylater, personal loans, and SME credit  to become India's most trusted financial partner for the masses. Design credit and risk models that unlock formal credit for millions of underserved sellers and users, many for the first time. Partner with product, tech, and analytics teams to grow lending AUM from ₹250 Cr today toward ₹20,000 Cr by 2030. AI Services (MAS) Build AI agents that reimagine manual, people-heavy business processes  starting with contact center services for enterprise clients. Own end-to-end client outcomes  taking full accountability for resolution across voice, chat, and workflow automation. Work at the frontier of India's AI-services wave across 10+ languages, always-on, building the playbook rather than inheriting one. Grocery Build the lowest-cost grocery supply chain in India, unbundling costs and unlocking latent supply to win on price. Design and test category, pricing, and network innovations (like the drop-point model) to make grocery structurally cheaper than every other player, online or offline. Scale Meesho Grocery from an early bet into India's first true e-grocery marketplace, working across category, fulfillment, and tech. Because we're not building a company. We're building a movement. Because we don't care where you come from  we care where you're headed. Because here, your ideas don't need ten approvals  just tenacity. Because at Meesho, you're not just joining a job  you're launching your entrepreneurial journey. Ready to reimagine Bharat with us? Apply now. Dream big. Hustle hard. Win together.

sample:2026-2027:135:2.jd_text: Nation with NaMo: The Graduate Impact Leadership Program (GILP) 2027 Associate When you picture yourself at the beginning of your career, what comes to your mind? A cubicle? A 9-to-5 job? Building Excel models to structure financial products? Hustling to launch a product in a new city? Pitching your business idea to potential investors? Working as part of a larger software team on a subset of a project? Researching legal positions and advising clients? We are confident that most likely you will end up doing these things as part of a reputed organization, working with good people in a steady job. And there is absolutely nothing wrong with that. If this aligns with your career aspirations, you can stop reading now, and we wish you the best in your career. However, if this is not quite enough for you, imagine this: Sitting in a village, understanding local issues and political trends. Brainstorm with your team to design an impactful election campaign. Strategizing with political stakeholders. Crafting messages that shape public opinion. Engaging in grassroots implementation to bring the campaign to the masses. Developing policy suggestions for election manifestos. Analyzing real-time data to predict electoral outcomes. Witnessing the tangible impact of your work on real people by solving real problems. And doing all this while supporting Prime Minister Modi and his party in their vision to build a new India. If this vision excites you, we have a role for you. If making a real impact is your priority, we welcome you to the Graduate Impact Leadership Program (GILP). Our teams background We are a diverse team of passionate, talented young individuals on a mission to make India better through our work. We are creating a platform for young professionals to create real impact by supporting senior political leaders on electioneering, party capability building, and governance. Our team members come from some of the most prestigious academic institutions in the country, including IIT Kanpur, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Delhi, IIT Bombay, ISB Hyderabad, NLSIU Bangalore, SRCC, LSR and IIT Guwahati What does GILP offer? Every year, lakhs of bright minds graduate from top educational institutes in India and enter the corporate sector, yet the best minds often miss the chance to tackle the nation's most pressing issues. GILP aims to bridge this gap. For college graduates, GILP offers a program where passionate individuals interested in nation-building can actively engage with and contribute to the political ecosystem through direct interactions. It is one of the most ambitious talent development initiatives in our field, aligning with the best global programs in the corporate world. 1. Unique Experience: You will get a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to build a fulfilling career in an upcoming space, a chance to work with political stakeholders at all levels to gain in-depth exposure about politics and a real chance to contribute towards solving interesting, unsolved problems at scale. 2. Accelerated learning & growth: You will be part of a small handpicked team of diverse, passionate and talented individuals who will constantly challenge, support and work with you to achieve extraordinary outcomes. GILP will set you on the 9 year path to joining the organizational leadership. 3. Hands-on mentorship: As part of this program, you will be mentored by a team of seasoned professionals who have pioneered the evolution of this space and undertaken various electoral campaigns across the country. 4. Competitive remuneration: We understand the value of the talent we have in sustaining our success and we offer competitive remuneration as part of our commitment to our people. About the role - GILP Political Consultant Starting in the summer of 2027, Political Consultants will join various project teams, advising senior clients in the political domain. They will be involved in multiple election campaigns and tackle some of the most challenging policy and governance issues facing the country. Throughout these campaigns, political consultants interact closely with political leaders and organizers at the constituency, district, state, and national levels. This role offers significant exposure and opportunities but also comes with high expectations for maintaining confidentiality, demonstrating exemplary client management skills, and delivering strong performance. What are we looking for in our Associates? As part of GILP, we are looking for team members at the associate level who demonstrate the following traits: 1. Academic Excellence: Combine an impressive academic record with strong technical skills 2. Prioritise Impact: Optimise for impact above everything else 3. Structured Problem Solving: Tackle complex situations through effective and structured problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking 4. Effective Communication: Possesses strong written and verbal communication skills - both individually and in a group setting 5. Initiative: Adapt to dynamic and ambiguous situations with a clear bias for action 6. Teamwork: Contribute to the strong team ethic and work towards the success of the entire team 7. Leadership Skills: Display the requisite leadership qualities to take ideas forward 8. Strong Ethics: Possess uncompromising ethical principles Eligibility To be eligible to apply for the Political Consultant position in GILP, you must: 1. Be a final-year student at a top engineering, law, commerce, science, or arts college in the country. 2. Be graduating in 2027 from a graduate/undergraduate course (3, 4, or 5-year integrated programs) at such a college. Please note that postgraduate candidates are not eligible for GILP.

sample:2026-2027:18:2.jd_text: Description Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets. Our Quantitative Researchers are embedded within the following teams: Alpha Researcher: As a member of the Alpha Researcher team, you will be involved in developing market-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models. Data Scientist: As a member of the Data Science team, you will be involved in parsing and analyzing large data sets, working on discovering and obtaining new sources of data and collaborating with the Alpha and Strategy team to build predictive machine learning models. Strategy Researcher: As a member of the Strategy team, you will be developing systematic strategies based on a variety of machine learning and statistical methods. The data you train and validate comes from actual market trading When you apply for a Quantitative Researcher role at Trexquant, we will first assess you on the core skills required for the Quantitative Researcher. During the interview process, we will be able to get to know you better, learn about your strengths and match you to the best research team that closely aligns with your skills and preference. Your Responsibilities: Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals Parse data sets to be used for future alpha(strategy) development Investigate and implement state-of-the-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance Collaborate with experienced and resourceful quantitative researchers to carry out experiments and test hypothesis using simulations Requirements Graduate degree (Bachelors, Masters, or PhD) in any STEM discipline from a prestigious institution Passion for machine learning and quantitative finance Strong problem-solving skills Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player Proficient in programming languages such as Python Previous experience in alpha research and the development of trading signals and strategies The role is also open for candidates graduating from Tier 1 campuses in 2027 Benefits Competitive compensation with bonus tied to the performance of algorithms you develop Work in a collaborative and friendly environment, participate in decision-making process for research direction, and have opportunity to lead on new ideas Pre-tax commuter benefits Weekly company meals

sample:2026-2027:490:2.jd_text: About Waterfly Waterfly builds electric, autonomous craft that fly a few metres above the sea, moving cargo at nearaircraft speed for a tenth of the cost of air freight. We started at IIT Madras, build every craft in-house in Chennai, and aim to be the cheapest and fastest way to move goods across the world. What to Expect We are hiring Graduate Engineers from the 2027 batch to design and analyse Pelican, our 10-tonne electric sea-skimming cargo craft. You will join a small team of engineers who take the craft from a blank page to a flight test, with your focus on CAD, CFD and FEA, and you will own the analysis of a subsystem within your first few months. The role is full-time and based in Chennai, with travel to test sites. You will join in summer 2027 and report to the CTO. The engineering has no textbook answer yet. Flying in ground effect cuts drag and adds lift, giving better lift-to-drag in our tests, and that is what lets a battery-powered craft cover real distances. Our patent pending blended wing-hull-body has scaled from a 3 kg model in 2025 to the 300 kg Hummingbird, which has flown autonomously since August 2026. Aerodynamics, hydrodynamics, structures, batteries, avionics and autonomy sit in one team, so your models become carbon-fibre parts within weeks, and flight data tells you how good they were. Expect direct mentorship from the founders, fast and honest feedback, and a pace that picks up around test campaigns. What Youll Do Design. Build and own CAD models of the craft and its subsystems: wings and hull, hydrofoils, composite structure, battery and motor installations. Start with hand calculations, then turn them into geometry our workshop can build.  Simulate. Run CFD on aerodynamics in ground effect and on planing and take-off hydrodynamics, and FEA on composite structures under flight, landing and wave loads. Set up meshes, boundary conditions and convergence checks you can defend.  Validate. Compare your models with hand calculations, coupon tests and data from lake and sea trials, and fix the model or the design when they disagree.  Document for certification. Produce the design, analysis and safety evidence that class societies such as Bureau Veritas and the Indian Register of Shipping need to approve a new type of vessel.  Work across the stack. Help build what you design in our workshop, support teammates on other subsystems, take part in design reviews, and pick up whatever the craft needs that week. What Youll Bring  A strong grasp of physics and maths. You reach for a first-principles estimate before a simulation. Hands-on experience with CAD and at least one of CFD or FEA, from coursework, research or a project, and the judgement to spot a result that cannot be right.  Depth in aerodynamics, hydrodynamics, or structures and composites, and real curiosity about the rest.  Python or MATLAB to automate analysis, run parameter sweeps and post-process results.  You have designed or built real hardware, such as a competition vehicle, drone, rocket, robot, boat or your own project, and can explain what broke and why.  High ownership and speed. You care about getting the craft flying, not about whose job something is.  Clear writing. You can produce an analysis report that someone else can act on.  Good to have: composite laminate or buckling analysis; free-surface or ground-effect CFD; planing hulls or hydrofoils; tools such as SolidWorks, CATIA, ANSYS, Abaqus, STAR-CCM+ or OpenFOAM; or a student team such as Formula Student, solar car, aero-design, AUV or rocketry.

sample:2026-2027:490:4.jd_text: About Waterfly Over water, shippers choose between ships that take days and aircraft that cost about 20 times more. Waterfly, incubated at IIT Madras, is building the mode in between: electric, autonomous craft that fly just above the sea at near-aircraft speed for a tenth of the cost of air freight. What to Expect We are hiring Management Consultants from the 2027 batch to map, and help shape, the rules that let a new kind of vehicle operate. You will work directly with the CEO and CBO, own a regulatory area within your first few months, and turn what you find into plans the company can act on. The role is full-time and based in Chennai, with travel to regulators, class societies and partners. You will join in summer 2027 and report to the CBO. Our craft fly a few metres above the water, so they are regulated as vessels, not aircraft: Type B wing-inground craft under IMO guidelines, and vessels under Indias Merchant Shipping Act, 2025. That is a faster path, but much of it has never been applied to an uncrewed, battery-electric craft with a blended wing-hull-body, or to the charging stations, offshore data centres, and defence and government uses around it. Your work decides how fast our 300 kg craft, flying autonomously since August 2026, and its successors reach paying customers. Expect direct mentorship from the founders, a seat in conversations with regulators and class societies early on, and enough engineering exposure to understand exactly what you are getting approved. What Youll Do  Craft regulation. Study the rules for blended wing-hull-body craft and other new designs, including IMO wing-in-ground guidelines, class rules, uncrewed-vessel rules and national law, and map the path from approval in principle to sea trials and a permit to operate.  Charging stations and data centres. Work out the approvals for quay-side chargers, ocean charging hubs and offshore data centres: siting, grid connection, safety and environmental clearances, and data rules.  Defence and government. Study defence procurement and export rules, government programmes, grants and maritime policy such as Sagarmala, and find where Waterfly fits.  Work with approvers. Prepare submissions and briefs for class societies such as Bureau Veritas and the Indian Register of Shipping, DG Shipping and maritime boards, and track every open requirement to closure.  Turn rules into requirements. Work with engineers to turn regulations into design requirements and test plans, from stability and propulsion drawings to cargo securing, so the evidence we produce matches what approvers need.What Youll Bring  Structured research. You can read a 170-page regulation, find what applies to us, and summarise it in a page someone can act on.  Working technical knowledge, or the ability to build it fast: enough to discuss stability, batteries, charging and autonomy with engineers.  Clear writing. You can draft a submission, policy note or briefing that a regulator or founder can act on.  Confidence with senior stakeholders in government, defence and industry, and the patience to see a process through.  Attention to detail. You track requirements, deadlines and evidence without dropping a thread.  High ownership and speed. You care about getting the first cargo flying, not about whose job something is.  Good to have: exposure to maritime, aviation, energy or defence regulation; policy, legal or public-sector internships; familiarity with IMO, IEC or ISO standards; an interest in deep-tech hardware.
